sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipex pixel packer Memory1 pitch register (DCMIPP_PxPPM1PR)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.92 "DCMIPP Pipex pixel packer Memory1 pitch register (DCMIPP_PxPPM1PR)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1962.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x9DC + 0x400 * (x - 1), (x = 1 to 1)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:15 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 14:0 PITCH[14:0]: Number of bytes between the address of two consecutive lines.
It is assumed to be a multiple of 16, hence its bits 3:0 are always at 0x0. It ranges to
32Kbytes, to allow a double-width buffer, containing a 4-kpixel wide 32 bpp picture. PITCH
is used also for Memory2 (there is no need to differentiate the pitch of Memory1/Memory2).
